title: Add Pollen Craft to app catalog
author: tomdacatto
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #10973

- Lists the live HTML5 game at https://tomdacat.itch.io/pollen-craft.
- Links the public standalone source at https://github.com/tomdacatto/pollen-craft.
- Marks the app as BYOP; itch uses Pollinations device authorization and keeps the delegated key in the game tab only.
- Keeps the monorepo change to one 20-line catalog entry rather than adding the full game source under `apps/`.
- Validated the catalog JSON and all four focused app-management tests on current `main`.

gist.headline: A New Craft in the Garden
gist.blurb: Pollen Craft has landed in the app catalog: a live HTML5 game where the hive gets a little more hands-on. It brings its own delegated key, keeps it in the game tab, and leaves the source out in the open.
gist.summary: Added a 20-line app-catalog entry for Pollen Craft, linking its live itch.io HTML5 game and public standalone GitHub source while marking it as a BYOP app using Pollinations device authorization.
gist.impact: People can now discover and launch Pollen Craft from the catalog, with its delegated Pollinations key kept inside the active game tab.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Pollen Craft as a cozy little browser game garden: Polli is actively placing pixel flower-and-hive craft pieces on a tiny game board beside a retro CRT showing the game. A small open-source booklet and a key-shaped pollen token represent the public source and delegated in-tab authorization, with code-plants and flowers making the catalog addition feel like a new garden plot.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute bee mascot with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blush, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings, wearing a tiny gardener apron as she arranges flower-and-hive craft tiles in a small HTML5 game garden beside a glowing retro CRT; an open source-code booklet and a pollen-shaped key token sit nearby among code-plants. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, subtle pixel-font text: 'POLLEN CRAFT', emotionally warm and nostalgic.
